CLASS cl_neutral_flow DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_cell,
        cell_id TYPE i,
        bucket_id TYPE i,
        amount TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
        stamp TYPE d,
        label_text TYPE c LENGTH 12,
      END OF ty_cell.
    TYPES tt_cell TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cell WITH EMPTY KEY.
    CLASS-METHODS:
      transform
      IMPORTING VALUE(it_cells) TYPE tt_cell
                VALUE(iv_switch) TYPE i
      EXPORTING VALUE(et_cells) TYPE tt_cell.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS cl_neutral_flow IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform BY DATABASE PROCEDURE FOR HDB
                   LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT OPTIONS READ-ONLY.
    DECLARE lv_switch INTEGER := :iv_switch;
    IF (:lv_switch = 0 OR :lv_switch IS NULL) THEN
      et_cells = SELECT cell_id, bucket_id, amount,
        stamp, LOWER(label_text) AS label_text FROM :it_cells;
    ELSEIF (:lv_switch BETWEEN 1 AND 9) THEN
      et_cells = SELECT cell_id, bucket_id,
        CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12, 2)) AS amount,
        stamp, REGEXP_REPLACE(label_text, 'x', '') AS label_text
        FROM :it_cells WHERE cell_id NOT IN (SELECT cell_id FROM :it_cells
                                             WHERE label_text = ' ');
    ELSE
      et_cells = SELECT cell_id, bucket_id, amount,
        stamp, SESSION_CONTEXT('NEUTRAL_MODE') AS label_text
        FROM :it_cells;
    END IF;
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
